$comment: Which of our modules implement which upstream spec file.
Purpose: turn 'bazaar.md changed' into 'these four files need review'. A drift alert that names
only the spec that moved costs an hour of rediscovery every time; one that names the code costs
minutes. That difference is what decides whether the maintenance system actually gets used.
Maintained BY HAND and reviewed whenever a module moves. The drift check validates that every
path listed here still exists, so a stale map fails loudly instead of quietly pointing at
nothing — a map that lies is worse than no map, because it is trusted.
`humanOnly: true` marks the hard wall: paths where
automation files an issue with evidence and STOPS. A human writes those diffs, always. These are
the places where a plausible-looking patch that passes every test can still be catastrophically
wrong, and where the audit signs off on human-authored code.

specs/x402-specification-v2.md.summary: Core protocol: envelopes, facilitator surface, error codes, discovery response shapes.

modules.why: the /verify, /settle, /supported surface and the request envelope
§9 error codes are a wire contract reproduced verbatim
response shapes and the lastUpdated type disagreement

specs/extensions/bazaar.md.summary: Discovery extension: cataloging trigger, filters, search, EXTENSION-RESPONSES.

modules.why: validation, soft-drop rules, routeTemplate handling, ownership
both discovery endpoints and the EXTENSION-RESPONSES encoding
the seven filters, pagination, and cursor semantics
items-vs-resources asymmetry; getting it backwards breaks stock clients silently
what a seller declares must match what the spec catalogs
the live assertion that the whole loop still works

specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact.md.summary: Generic `exact` scheme: the guarantees every network profile must provide.

modules.why: verify/settle wrapper and its rejection contract

specs/schemes/exact/scheme_exact_stellar.summary: `exact` on Stellar: auth entries, expiration ledgers, payload shape, rejection codes.

modules.why: our Stellar profile is written against this document

the on-chain enforcement of the ceiling and single-use

modules.why: our profile mirrors its guarantee structure; divergence needs justifying
